projects.name: Milestone Renovate
projects.description: A renovation planning website for Sydney homeowners, pairing guided tools with practical guidance from the first idea to the first conversation.
projects.solution: We built a forest-green and gold planning platform around four guided tools: an indicative renovation cost planner, a moodboard design studio, a renovation questionnaire and an NSW DA or CDC approvals guide. Enquiries are validated and delivered by email, with indicative estimates and a call request rather than a confirmed booking. The site distinguishes owner-supplied project photography from concept references.
keyFeatures: Indicative renovation cost planner with ranges, timelines and stated assumptions
Guided design studio that builds a moodboard from the visitor's selections
Renovation questionnaire feeding a validated email enquiry flow
NSW approvals guide helping visitors gauge DA or CDC pathways

image.alt: Milestone Renovate homepage with a forest-green header, gold call to action and an AI-generated renovation concept image
